headline: Sanderson Farms Championship: FedExCup Fall drama opens in Jackson
whyCareReason: Following Team USA's Presidents Cup victory, the PGA Tour Fall swing moves to Jackson where livelihood and PGA Tour cards are on the line.
teaser: Thursday 1 October to Sunday 4 October at Country Club of Jackson. The FedExCup Fall swing intensifies as pros battle for top-125 card security.
story:
Why this one matters: With the euphoria of Team USA's 18.5-11.5 Presidents Cup victory at Medinah in the rearview mirror, professional golf returns to its most visceral battlefield: the FedExCup Fall.

The Sanderson Farms Championship in Jackson, Mississippi represents real careers on the line. For players ranked between 51 and 125, every birdie at Country Club of Jackson carries immense value, offering guaranteed starts for 2027 and access to multimillion-dollar Signature Events.

The tournament has established a proud reputation as a launching pad for future stars, from Sam Burns and Cameron Champ to Kevin Yu. With 500 FedExCup points to the winner, Sunday in Jackson will produce life-changing moments.
stakes: The winner earns a two-year PGA Tour exemption, entry into the Sentry and PGA Championship, and crucial FedExCup points.
rivalryAngle: High-stakes individual survival: fringe tour members versus seasoned veterans protecting their playing privileges.
